SurfaceDecals - decal, effect and light-cookie textures for the night jewellery-store scene
Prepared October 14, 2026. Not yet imported or checked in Unity.

Three groups. Per-file SHA-256 hashes, pixel sizes and sources are in sources.json.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1. Original project work (project-owned)
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
All PNG files except SmokePuff_Kenney*.png and LeafLitter_Wet*.png:

   ShoePrint_*  Fingerprints_Atlas  GlassHandprint_Latent  GlassShards_Scatter*
   GlassCrumbs_Tempered*  ConcreteCrack_*  AsphaltCrackSeal*  Puddle_*  GrimeStreaks_Wall
   DirtTracked_Entrance  DirtEdge_WallBase  WaterStain_*  OilStain*  ChewingGum_Scatter*
   LitterScatter*  FloorScuffs_Heel  FloorScratches_Fine  DragMarks_Floor*  DustFilm_MissingItems
   PryMarks_DoorFrame*
   TyreSkid  TyreTread_Mud*  DustMotes_Atlas  LightShaft_Gradient  FogPuff_Atlas  LensGlow
   LensFlare_Streak  LensFlare_Ghosts  LensStarburst  Caustics_Tile  Cookie_*

   Author: this project (generated with Claude Code on October 14, 2026; Fingerprints_Atlas.png
   regenerated October 15, 2026 so that its developed row is the same print as its latent row).
   Made procedurally with Python (numpy, scipy, Pillow) by the scripts in Source~/
   (dutil.py, footprints.py, fingerprints.py, glass.py, cracks.py, puddles.py, surface.py,
   roadlitter.py, effects.py). No third-party image, photograph, font or scan was used as input.
   License: project-owned; no third-party rights or attribution requirements. The project may
   use, modify and redistribute them freely.
   Notes: the fingerprints are synthetic (generated ridge orientation fields and Gabor ridge
   growth) and do not reproduce any real person's prints. The shoe soles and the tyre tread are
   generic designs and do not copy any manufacturer's pattern or logo. No text, brand or logo
   appears in any image.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2. Kenney Particle Pack 1.1 (CC0 1.0)
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Files: SmokePuff_Kenney01.png, SmokePuff_Kenney04.png, SmokePuff_Kenney07.png,
          SmokePuff_Kenney08.png
   Title: Particle Pack (1.1), files smoke_01.png, smoke_04.png, smoke_07.png, smoke_08.png
          from the "PNG (Transparent)" folder
   Author: Kenney Vleugels (Kenney.nl)
   Source: https://kenney.nl/assets/particle-pack
   Downloaded from the GitHub copy https://github.com/Mrcocacola21/FATE
          @ 3a07cfc8be6f5141de67f360f4ff9aef7fecb0fd,
          packages/web/assets/vfx/vendor/kenney-particle-pack/ (the full pack with its
          License.txt; that repository's own licence covers its code, not these CC0 files)
   License: Creative Commons Zero, CC0 1.0 Universal
          https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
   Attribution: not required. Courtesy credit: "Smoke sprites: Kenney (www.kenney.nl), CC0".
   Changes: palette PNG converted to RGBA; colour of fully transparent pixels set to white; renamed.

   License.txt shipped with the pack (verbatim):
	Particle Pack (1.1)
	by Kenney Vleugels (Kenney.nl)
	Additional credit for creating filter templates:
	Indigo Ray, Craig Nisbet, Zoltan Erdokovy, Heliagon, ThreeDee, Killst4r and Tim2501
	License (Creative Commons Zero, CC0)
	http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
	You may use these assets in personal and commercial projects.
	Credit (Kenney or www.kenney.nl) would be nice but is not mandatory.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
3. ambientCG LeafSet024 (CC0 1.0) - derived work
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Files: LeafLitter_Wet.png, LeafLitter_Wet_Normal.png, LeafLitter_Wet_MetallicSmoothness.png
   Title: Leaf Set 024 (photoscanned beech leaves), 2K-JPG Color, NormalGL, Opacity, Roughness
   Author: ambientCG (Lennart Demes)
   Source: https://ambientcg.com/view?id=LeafSet024 (asset id confirmed in the ambientCG catalogue
          listing src/data/materials.Popular.1.txt of github.com/repalash/cc0textures-threejs)
   Downloaded from the GitHub copy https://github.com/achrefelouafi/ProceduralBuildingsThreeJS
          @ 6c19f1b1f14408353989ad26cda27f1e1ede5e91, blender/textures/LeafSet024/
          (Git LFS objects through media.githubusercontent.com; each file's SHA-256 equals its
          LFS oid; the repository README states its ambientCG sets are CC0; its MIT licence
          covers the code only)
   License: CC0 1.0 Universal https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
          (ambientCG publishes all assets under CC0; see https://docs.ambientcg.com/license/,
          as already recorded for NightMaterials and PBRExterior)
   Attribution: not required. Courtesy credit: "Leaves: ambientCG.com, CC0".
   Changes: the nine leaves were cut from the 3 x 3 atlas, recoloured from summer green to wet
          autumn browns/ochres, scaled to 62-98 mm, rotated and flipped (normal vectors rotated
          accordingly) and scattered 58 times over a 1 m decal; smoothness = 0.55 + 0.35 * (1 -
          roughness). Script: Source~/leaves_photo.py.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Rejected / not used (see the asset-batch notes): ambientCG Footsteps, Fingerprints, ChewingGum,
TireTracks, Scratches, Smear, SurfaceImperfections, AsphaltDamage decals (CC0, but no reachable
mirror); Red Eclipse decals (CC BY-SA by default); Godot decals-demo puddles (256 px, provenance
not stated per file); BabylonJS Assets flare/lens-dirt textures (repo-wide CC BY 4.0 but the
individual textures' origins are not documented); three.js example lens-flare textures (licence
of the image files not stated); NIST fingerprint databases (real people's biometrics).
